description: Patch schema for local Foundation-1 structured loop generation through ComfyUI.

unmapped_ui_parameters.negative_prompt: ComfyUI-Foundation-1 exposes only one structured tags input. The production plugin preserves the existing negative prompt control by folding it into the tags string as an avoidance phrase before patching node 2.tags.
unmapped_ui_parameters.audio_length: Foundation-1 duration is derived from BPM and bar count by round(bars * 4 / bpm * 60). The production plugin maps requested audio duration to the nearest supported BPM/bar pair unless scene overrides provide foundation1_bpm and foundation1_bars.
unmapped_ui_parameters.hf_cache_dir: Model downloads are handled by the Slopperly model manager, not by generation-time Hugging Face calls.
unmapped_ui_parameters.local_files_only: The Comfy node must find pre-downloaded local model files; generation-time downloads are not part of the production path.

output.contract: Comfy SaveAudio returns one readable FLAC artifact at 44100 Hz with duration matching the selected Foundation-1 BPM/bar mapping within tolerance; FoundationMusicPlugin converts that local artifact to a real WAV before returning to the Blender UI path.
